name: final_nail_depth
description: how far the nail ends up driven into the wall (m)

name: nail_fully_driven
description: 1 if the nail was driven all the way in, else 0

name: time_to_drive_nail
description: fraction of the episode taken to drive the nail in (1.0 = never)

name: mean_head_to_target
description: mean distance from the hammer head to the nail's driven-in pose (m)

name: frac_steps_head_at_target
description: fraction of steps the hammer head hovers at that pose

name: frac_steps_caging_hammer
description: fraction of steps the fingers bracket the hammer handle

name: frac_steps_gripper_squeezing
description: fraction of steps the gripper is commanded to squeeze shut

name: frac_steps_hammer_held
description: fraction of steps the hammer is actually lifted and in the hand

name: max_hammer_lift
description: highest the hammer is raised above where it started (m)

name: mean_hammer_flatness
description: how flat the hammer is held, 1 = perfectly level, 0 = fully tipped

name: nail_progress_without_hammer
description: nail travel that happened without the hammer head on the nail (m)

name: mean_action_magnitude
description: mean size of the arm's per-step movement command
